Finding F-006: potential underbilling on contract C-2028, SKU MFG-1003, customer Silverline Pumps Ltd.

Root cause: the contractual annual price escalation was never applied in billing (Clauses A.2 and 4.2).

Calculation: USD 111.00 (base price) x (1 + 2.5%) [2024-05-01] x (1 + 2.5%) [2025-05-01] = USD 116.62. Billed price: USD 111.00.

Scope: 20 invoice lines, 2024-05-15 to 2025-12-15. Potential underbilling: USD 44,106.02. Estimated recoverable: USD 39,607.21.

Recommended actions:
1. Pricing & Billing Master Data to load the escalated Unit Price into the billing price master from 2024-05-15.
2. Prepare a supplementary invoice for the under-billed lines.

Please review and approve before any action is taken."}
